title: Answer: give the new tab one word, /assistant

text:
That is all it needs. The skill tells it everything else.
It cannot type into this tab's prompt box. It reaches me two other ways. It writes your words into my inbox, a file I read at every step. And Claude Code lets one session on this machine message another, so it also pings me directly; that arrives at my next step, usually within a minute.
It answers you itself, in seconds, here in the dev bar, so you do not wait on me.
Also: I was typing clock times into my card titles by guess, and they were wrong. The time on each card is stamped automatically and is right. I have stopped putting times in titles.
